name: MagicX Zero 28 port validation via GitHub Actions

description: Baseline: GH-hosted validation workflow green (validation_ok=1). Zero 28 port passes DTS compile + script + partition reference checks.

asi.hypothesis: GH-hosted port validation is the honest proxy for a full build when no 180GiB runner exists
asi.note: dispatch requires workflow on default branch; pushed validate workflow to knulli-main (fast-forward)

description: Strengthened validation: added boot.img magic (ARMd zImage, gzip ramdisk), root=/dev/mmcblk0p4 cmdline, and panel-identity guards (h028b23, no RTP40WV101B/cap_touch). All green.

asi.hypothesis: boot-contract + panel-identity guards catch regressions the basic file-existence checks miss
asi.finding: A133 boots via Android-style boot.img (zImage+ramdisk+cmdline), NOT boot.scr/extlinux (Rockchip-only); boot.scr staleness is cosmetic
asi.zero28_matches: xu20-v32 reference on root=mmcblk0p4, console=ttyS0, rdinit=/init, env mmc_root=p7

description: Added genimage flash-layout parity guard (Zero 28 offsets/sizes must equal xu20-v32 reference). Green.

asi.hypothesis: flash-layout drift (offsets/sizes) is the highest-severity regression class; parity with known-good reference catches it
asi.gpt_layout: boot=mmcblk0p1, env=p2, env-redund=p3, boot-resource=p4 (root=/dev/mmcblk0p4 = FAT w/ squashfs), userdata=p5
asi.env_mmc_root: p7 is generic Allwinner leftover (identical in xu20-v32) — not authoritative

description: Added boot_package.fex integrity check: extracted u-boot/monitor/scp/dtb blobs must byte-match committed source (proves shipped boot package == DTS-derived boot package). Green.

asi.hypothesis: boot_package.fex can drift from its DTS/blobs silently; byte-integrity check catches it
asi.finding: committed fex byte-contains committed u-boot/monitor/scp AND dtb.bin identical to fresh DTS compile (148310 bytes)
asi.note: proves the shipped boot package is internally consistent — no hidden drift

description: Fixed measure.sh dispatch ref (was stale feature branch, now knulli-main). This run genuinely exercised all 8 checks in CI for the first time: DTS, scripts, files, genimage refs, boot.img magic, panel identity, flash-layout parity, boot_package.fex integrity. Green.

asi.hypothesis: dispatch ref must be knulli-main so CI runs the latest workflow, not a stale branch copy
asi.correction: runs #5-#7 silently re-ran the ORIGINAL workflow (stale ref 67e13a4); this run is the first to exercise boot-contract/panel/layout/fex-integrity checks in CI

description: Added uImage/uInitrd magic validity checks (ARMd arm64 Image for uImage, gzip for uInitrd). Also confirmed uImage is a shared 17.3MB kernel across all A133 boards (not a Zero 28 anomaly). Green.

asi.hypothesis: corrupted uImage/uInitrd would pass existence-only checks; magic validity catches it
asi.finding: uImage is 17.3MB shared across ALL A133 boards (magicx-zero-40, xu20-v32, trimui-smart-pro, powkiddy-v20) while boot.img-zImage is per-device; Zero 28 not anomalous

description: Added flashed boot.img kernel-integrity check: the Android boot image (partitions/boot.img) must embed the committed boot.img-zImage at the Android page boundary. Confirmed byte-identical. Green.

asi.hypothesis: the flashed boot.img can drift from its source zImage; embedding check is the strongest no-drift guarantee
asi.finding: partitions/boot.img (ANDROID!+sun50i_arm64) embeds boot.img-zImage at page offset 2048 — byte identical
asi.env_img: byte-identical to xu20-v32 reference (known-good boot env)
